name: Xoroth: Drag Through Hell summons a distant party member (#9597)
contract: #9597 reports Drag Through Hell (804773) does not summon the targeted player at the end of the cast. Spell.dbc comparison shows 804773.RangeIndex=1 (SpellRange.dbc[1] 'Self Only', 0-0 yd) where the native spell it is modeled on, Ritual of Summoning (7720, same Effect[0]=SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PLAYER, same ONLY_PEACEFUL_TARGETS attribute), carries RangeIndex=13 ('Anywhere', 0-50000 yd). Spell::CheckRange (Spell.cpp:~7265) enforces RangeIndex generically against m_targets.GetUnitTarget() (the cast packet's explicit unit target) before Spell::CheckCast's own SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PLAYER branch (Spell.cpp:6629-6639, which separately reads the caster's selection via Player::GetTarget()/UNIT_FIELD_TARGET, requires the resolved target to share the caster's group via Player::IsInSameRaidWith, and requires no summon already pending) is ever reached, so a 'Self Only' range made any cast on a party member at nonzero distance fail with SPELL_FAILED_OUT_OF_RANGE (97) before the summon-specific logic could run. The fix widens 804773's RangeEntry to 'Anywhere' in AscensionXorothContracts.cpp::ApplyContracts, the same load-time SpellInfo correction mechanism already used there for Flesh Hook Pull's range. This scenario groups a Xoroth caster with a same-faction ally, sets the caster's selection to the ally via CMSG_SET_SELECTION (opcode 317, so the SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON_PLAYER branch resolves the same ally rather than failing SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS for no selection), separates them by 20 yd (well past the 'Self Only' range's 0 yd, while staying within line of sight on the same open, flat, widely-reused test ground so the measurement isolates the range defect and does not also exercise line-of-sight, which 804773 does not ignore, unlike 7720's own SPELL_ATTR2_IGNORE_LINE_OF_SIGHT attribute -- a separate, unconfirmed observation outside #9597's reported symptom). 804773.Totem[0]=5565 (Infernal Stone) is a non-consumed focus-item check unrelated to the reported range defect (the reporter's own words, 'does not use stone', describe the stone-free summon outcome, not this unconsumed carry-requirement), so the caster carries one before casting. The scenario then casts 804773 with that ally as the explicit unit target: before the fix the cast fails with SPELL_FAILED_OUT_OF_RANGE at that separation; after the fix it completes.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
Carry the Infernal Stone 804773's Totem[0] requires
Select the ally: EffectSummonPlayer resolves the caster's selection, not the cast target map
CONTRACT: the cast on a distant party member does not fail with SPELL_FAILED_OUT_OF_RANGE (#9597)
The cast against the distant ally completed rather than failing (804773 has a 5000 ms cast time)
